name: Form DIR-8: Intimation by Director of Non-Disqualification
statutory_authority: Section 164(2) of Companies Act, 2013 & Rule 14(1) of Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014
template_text:
FORM DIR-8
Intimation by Director
[Pursuant to Section 164(2) and Rule 14(1) of Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014]

Registration No. of Company / CIN: [As per Target Company]
Nominal Capital: [As per Capital Structure]
Paid-up Capital: [As per Capital Structure]

To,
The Board of Directors,
{{target_company_name}}

I, {{director_name}}, son/daughter of {{father_name}}, resident of {{residential_address}}, having Director Identification Number (DIN) {{din}}, hereby give notice that I am/was a director in the companies listed in the Annexure.

I hereby declare that:
1. I have not been disqualified under sub-section (1) of Section 164 of the Companies Act, 2013;
2. I have not incurred disqualification under sub-section (2) of Section 164 of the Companies Act, 2013 in respect of any company during the financial year {{financial_year}};
3. No company in which I am or have been a director has failed to file financial statements or annual returns for any continuous period of three financial years, or failed to repay deposits or interest thereon.


Signature: _________________________
Name: {{director_name}}
DIN: {{din}}
Date: [Date of Board Meeting]
Place: [Place of Signing]
